description: Get one host's evidence in full: verification state and freshness (last check, next check, overdue), the latest xcelsior-bench run with its sustained-load numbers and the dates and verdicts of up to ten earlier runs, reputation tier and score, and the 30-day job success rate with the counts behind it. The same read model the marketplace listings show. Use to compare two hosts or to check a host before launching on it. Returns 404 for an unknown host. Read-only and free.
name: get_host_evidence
title: Get host evidence
